description.zh:
返回结果显示的语言。取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- zh-CN: Chinese

- en-US (default): English
The unique ID of the address.

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。注意  由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. Make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns describe-cloud-gtm-address --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --address-id addr-895182181143680000 --region cn-hangzhou
